001package models;
002
003import java.io.Serializable;
004import java.time.LocalDateTime;
005import java.util.UUID;
006
007/**
008 * Student request to enroll in a course; may be pending, approved, or rejected.
009 */
010public class CourseRegistrationRequest implements Serializable {
011    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
012
013    private final String id;
014    private final String studentLogin;
015    private final String courseId;
016    private final String reason;
017    private final LocalDateTime createdAt;
018    private Status status;
019
020    /** Lifecycle state of a registration request. */
021    public enum Status {
022        PENDING,
023        APPROVED,
024        REJECTED
025    }
026
027    public CourseRegistrationRequest(String studentLogin, String courseId, String reason) {
028        this.id = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
029        this.studentLogin = studentLogin;
030        this.courseId = courseId;
031        this.reason = reason;
032        this.createdAt = LocalDateTime.now();
033        this.status = Status.PENDING;
034    }
035
036    public String getId() { return id; }
037    public String getStudentLogin() { return studentLogin; }
038    public String getCourseId() { return courseId; }
039    public String getReason() { return reason; }
040    public LocalDateTime getCreatedAt() { return createdAt; }
041    public Status getStatus() { return status; }
042
043    public void approve() { this.status = Status.APPROVED; }
044    public void reject() { this.status = Status.REJECTED; }
045
046    @Override
047    public String toString() {
048        return "CourseRegistrationRequest{" +
049                "id='" + id + '\'' +
050                ", studentLogin='" + studentLogin + '\'' +
051                ", courseId='" + courseId + '\'' +
052                ", status=" + status +
053                ", createdAt=" + createdAt +
054                (reason == null || reason.isBlank() ? "" : ", reason='" + reason + '\'') +
055                '}';
056    }
057}
058
